consequence.statement: This is an additive capability: it only enables new configuration of ssl.principal.mapping.rules and custom trusted CAs for Kafka brokers with type: custom authentication; environments that do not use these options are unaffected.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 adds the ability to configure ssl.principal.mapping.rules and custom trusted CAs on Kafka brokers using type: custom authentication; the evidence (a single changelog line) does not name the exact CRD fields or configuration paths, so the precise subject and change type are left undetermined, while the consequence is a purely additive, no-op capability for existing environments.
